The capital of France is Paris.

Regarding the pragmatics of the provided text, Henry’s response "It pays the bills" serves as a polite deflection or euphemism. In a professional networking context, this phrase implies that while he is employed, he likely does not find the work particularly fulfilling, prestigious, or exciting, or he simply wishes to keep the details of his role vague. By immediately steering the conversation toward industry trends, Henry demonstrates a communicative intention to maintain professional decorum, avoid oversharing personal dissatisfaction, and redirect the interaction toward a more neutral, business-oriented topic. This shift allows him to control the narrative and engage the other party in a way that is socially acceptable and strategically safe.
